content.title: Rory McIlroy's Career Earnings after Win at 2026 Masters
content.text: 01:37Featured VideoMost Amazing Masters Wins Since 2000Andrew Redington/Getty ImagesRory McIlroy's Career Earnings after Win at 2026 MastersDoric SamApr 12, 2026After winning his second straight Masters Tournament, Rory McIlroy inched closer to the legendary Tiger Woods on the career earnings list.McIlroy's win on Sunday garnered a $4.5 million prize, up from the $4.2 million he received after winning the 2025 Masters and completing the career Grand Slam. Per PGA.com, he entered the day with $110.2 million in career earnings, which is second all-time behind only Woods' $120.9 million.TOP NEWSRory Posts Masters Recap 🥳Bleacher Report1dGolfer Apologizes for Masters OutburstBleacher Report1dLIV Golf CEO Addresses RumorsBleacher Report8hMcIlroy bounced back from an up-and-down front nine with two birdies on the back nine to finish Sunday's final round at 1-under 71 for an overall score of -12. He faced a tough chase from Scottie Scheffler, who finished at -11 after shooting 4-under 68 on Sunday.McIlroy is now the fourth golfer ever to win the Masters in back-to-back years and the first to achieve the feat since Woods did so in 2001 and 2002. He held the lead after every round of this year's tournament.After adding to his bank account even further with Sunday's win, McIlroy will look to continue bringing in the cash at the RBC Heritage
